name: Give It Up or Turnit a Loose

podcast.body: This classic funk track, released in 1969, contains a distinctive "break" that is frequently sampled and is considered woven into the DNA of hip hop. The "break" refers to a 10-15 second section of bass guitar and drums that formed the backbone of 70s funk. Dean of rock critics Robert Christgau noted that between 1969 and 1971, Brown scored 17 top 10 R&B hits that reshaped black dancing and paved the way for disco. "The break in this 1969 classic from James Brown is woven into the DNA of hip hop."
